0022600016.text: Boston hosts Chicago in its fifth game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. The Celtics are 3-1, unbeaten at home at 3-0, riding a three-game win streak, and sit 2nd in the Atlantic, half a game back, and 3rd in the East. Chicago is 1-4 on a three-game losing streak, 0-2 at home, 4th in the Central and 12th in the East, and is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), while Jalen Smith (finger) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Boston is without Devin Carter (illness) and leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, following a 2-1 series win over Chicago in 2025-26.
